text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
When the dust settles on the heated<n>clash, Silence
Suzuka emerges<n>victorious.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The race now over, Silence Suzuka<n>makes a
revelation—Taiki's fiery<n>running touched her to the
core and<n>showed her what she was missing.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Both in search of higher speed,<n>Suzuka announces
her plans to run in<n>Hong Kong, while Taiki sets the
Yasuda Kinen as her next target.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With the Mile Championship behind<n>us, all that's
left is to wait for the<n>Umamusume of the Year
announcement. Will Taiki Shuttle<n>achieve her
ambition? Only time will<n>tell.
